decisive_items: skin fistula developed with pus extruding and an “orange peel” appearance of the overlying skin
Breast MRI revealed multiple oval and rounded lesions with irregular thick walls throughout the gland, extending to the skin, with peripheral enhancement
response.rationale: Periductal mastitis is more specifically supported by the combination of nipple retraction, skin fistula, and the described imaging findings, which are characteristic of this condition.

rejected.why: Less specific support and fewer matching clinical features.
